journeyTemplate.blurb: Accept the agreement, save your portal, read your scope and map, pay the first instalment, then book the kickoff call. After it, you approve a short written summary. That's the brief we build to.

milestones.detail: Optional, but handy: it puts the portal one tap away on your phone, and it opens like an app. Skip it if you'd rather not.

From now on, open AT Network from your home screen.

atn-signoff-site.detail: Both rounds are done. Type your full name to sign off the site. From here, changes to it are change requests.

atn-starmap.detail: Martyn: this is what we'll build the StarMap page from. Open what you sent us and check the questions and the report are final. Anything to change goes in the box. Otherwise type Final.

atn-stinger-ref.detail: The stingers are the short idents that open and close each podcast episode and YouTube video. Send us one or two examples you like, from any show, and a line on the feel you want. Links are best. We make a matching intro and outro from them.

atn-vsl-confirm.detail: As your launch gift, I'll make Martyn's full Foundations overview (about 3 minutes 40) into your Foundations VSL, re-edited in the First Light look. You get a widescreen version for desktop and a phone version, for the Foundations page and landing pages A and B, with one round of changes. We talked it through on 27 October. We've agreed it's built from Martyn's overview, with a limited splice of a Rich video and networking footage if you have them. Tick this if you're happy with that.

atn-vsl-networking.detail: Martyn's overview doesn't mention the live networking calls and breakout rooms, which Rich calls as valuable as the course. We'd like to cut in a few seconds of the real thing. Send any recordings you already have (with everyone's OK to use them), or tell us when your videographer can film one.

atn-vsl-originals.detail: For the Foundations VSL we need the best quality of Martyn's course overview: ideally the 4K master or the camera files, with no title or logo burned in. Pete may have them: Ben, could you ask him? If they don't exist, tell us and we'll work from the 1080p export we have. Want other footage in too, say of Rich and Ben? Send it here as well and we'll splice it in. Paste a link if the files are big.

atn-workbook.detail: Rich: upload the workbook, or paste a link to it. We use it as it is. Branding it is on the Phase 2 list. Due 3 business days after payment 1.

data.tagline: Your website and funnel, built in the open.
